messages:
tara: FYI running a regression: new quantized model (sable-v2-int8) shows rare streaming parse doubles when network drops last frame. Seen in staging connectors when requests have side effects.

maria: can you share a concrete trace?

tara: snippet: 
```
chunk1: '{\"action\": \"call\", \"name\": \"charge_card\"'
chunk2: ', \"args\": {\"amount\": 100}}'
chunk3: <lost>  <-- EOS missing
parser: EOFError
runtime: immediate retry -> downstream payment charged twice
```

ashley: quick idea: add 'side_effect_potential' flag when parser sees action==call + name present, even if args incomplete. If set, suppress auto-retry and return structured parse-error for manual handling.

maria: +1. Also consider deferred-retry: small quiesce window on EOF errors (derive N from chunk_gap telemetry). Combine both: quiesce to catch late frames, but if side_effect_potential flagged, prefer suppress.

eval-bot: propose canary: 8k synthetic streaming requests, inject tail-frame-drop at 0.7%, compare baseline, quiesce-150ms, quiesce-350ms, and parser-flag-only. Metrics: duplicate_invokes_per_100k, parse_fail_rate, added_latency_p95.

infra-bot: telemetry: chunk_gap_ms p50=20 p95=110 p99=260 (sable-v2-canary).

tara: sounds good. Implementation owners?

maria: i'll own RFC + signal matrix. Ashley take parser changes, Tara runtime quiesce + request flag plumbing.

ashley: will add unit fuzz for mid-token truncation and ensure parser emits 'partial_func_call' event without blocking.

tara: i'll add RequestState.side_effect_flag and wire to retry scheduler. Also expose retry_suppressed_due_to_flag in traces.

maria: acceptance: reduce duplicates by >90% on synthetic tail loss, parse-fail regressions <0.05%, and quiesce latency impact p95 < 7%.

eval-bot: will run and report.

maria: thanks all. i'll make the issues and assign reviewers. :thumbsup:
